meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目配置语言服务器，让代码诊断和跳转生效
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同语言配置 LSP 或修复编辑器诊断功能
copy.tagline_en: Configure language servers for your project to enable code diagnostics and navigation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to set up or fix LSP for different languages in your editor

howto.what: Claude 会先识别项目语言,再给对应语言服务器的安装与配置步骤,并写入配置文件,让报错检查、跳转定义、查找引用、重命名等编辑功能生效;它还会扫描项目检查状态,并实际跑一次诊断验证配置。
howto.when: 当你要求配置或安装语言服务器、修复“no LSP server configured”/“server not installed”报错,或选择服务器并写 LSP 配置文件时触发。

say.text: 给这个 Python 项目配置语言服务器
say.note: Claude 会按流程检测、安装并写配置。

say.text: 帮我装好 gopls 并写进 .opencode/lsp.json
say.note: 会生成配置片段并提示验证。

say.text: 用 verify 脚本检查一下 Rust 的 LSP 配置
say.note: 会实际跑一次诊断确认是否 OK。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude identifies the project language from file extensions, gives the matching builtin server install/config steps, writes the LSP config file, then verifies with a real diagnostics roundtrip. It can also scan a directory to report install/config status per language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to configure or install a language server, report 'no LSP server configured' or 'server not installed', or need to choose among servers and write an LSP config file.

say_en.text: Set up the language server for this Python project.
say_en.note: Claude will detect, install, and write the config.

say_en.text: Install gopls and add it to .opencode/lsp.json.
say_en.note: Produces a config snippet and suggests verifying.

say_en.text: Check that the Rust language server returns diagnostics.
say_en.note: Runs a real roundtrip and reports OK/FAIL.
